::: {#exr-finite-difference-cost}

#### The cost of finite differences

The derivative of the loss with respect to one [parameter](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-parameter) $\theta_i$ can be estimated by a finite difference,
$\paren{L(\theta_i + \epsilon) - L(\theta_i)} / \epsilon$ for a small $\epsilon$,
with every other parameter held fixed.
How many evaluations of the loss does that take to estimate the gradient with respect to $P$ parameters?

:::
